top_choice_rationale: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are a molecular design rule (a lipid neutral in blood and charged in the acidic endosome, with lipid polymorphism driving release) that is distinct from the 2023 Medicine prize on mRNA nucleoside modification, and its clinical effect is already large and independently validated (approved siRNA drug, mRNA vaccines at scale). Allocation to Cullis, Madden and Hope is contestable against MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer, but the citation is scoped to the formation principle. Targeted protein degradation (P001) is a close second: mechanistically strong but clinically unproven and crowded in credit, with PROTACs and cereblon glues possibly two discoveries. C-N coupling (P003) is mature but reads as a refinement of the 2010 prize.
